reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without a will) under the Registration of Title Act. The notice is issued by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement regarding the registration of land titles, which falls squarely under land-related matters as defined in Type 4 classification.
